issues.display_title: Issue #403: Refactor Utils ElasticSearch and UserFunctions Queries to GORM
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 23/07/26

✅ Implementation: Refactor Utils ElasticSearch and UserFunctions Queries

This document tracks the execution details for the utility query GORM refactor.

Phase 1: ElasticUsers Counter Queries

  • Target File:
    • src/Utils/ElasticSearch/ElasticUsers/ElasticUsers.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Replaced Raw query in AddCounterFollowerFollowingPosts with Table("followers_counts").Select(...).Where(...).Scan(&total).
    • Replaced Raw query for total_following in AddCounterFollowerFollowing with GORM chain query.
    • Replaced Raw query for total_followers in AddCounterFollowerFollowing with GORM chain query.
    • Preserved function signatures, return values, ElasticSearch index names, document IDs, and document fields.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 2: ElasticPost Counter Queries

  • Target File:
    • src/Utils/ElasticSearch/ElasticPost/ElasticPost.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Replaced total comment Raw query in AddCounterCommentPost with Table/Select/Where/Scan.
    • Replaced total comment Raw query in SetCounterCommentPostForBan with Table/Select/Where/Scan.
    • Preserved function signatures, return values, error wrapping, ElasticSearch index names, document IDs, and document fields.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 3: ElasticNotForPublic Counter Queries

  • Target File:
    • src/Utils/ElasticSearch/ElasticNotForPublic/ElasticNotForPublic.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Replaced reply count Raw query in AddCounterReplyCommentPost with Table/Select/Where/Scan.
    • Replaced reply count Raw query in AddCounterComment with Table/Select/Where/Scan.
    • Replaced comment like count Raw query in AddCounterComment with Table/Select/Where/Scan.
    • Preserved function signatures, return values, ElasticSearch index names, document IDs, and document fields.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 4: UserFunctions Utility Queries

  • Target File:
    • src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Replaced UpdateLastLogin raw update with Table("user_detail").Where("user_id = ?", userId).Update("last_login", lastLogin).
    • Replaced InsertElasticContainer raw insert with Table("elastic_containers").Create(map[string]interface{}{...}).
    • Replaced GetBookmarksBetweenUsers raw join query with Table("bookmark b").Select(...).Joins(...).Where(...).Scan(&bookmarks).
    • Preserved function signatures, return values, map keys, and caller-facing behavior.
  • Status: Completed.

Verification

  • Ran gofmt on all modified Go files.
  • Ran:
go test ./src/Utils/ElasticSearch/... ./src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions
  • Result: passed.
  • Ran scoped raw SQL scan:
rg -n "Config\.DB\.(Raw|Exec)\(" src\Utils\ElasticSearch src\Utils\Functions\UserFunctions\UsersFunctions.go
  • Result: no matches.

Notes

  • Existing unrelated dirty files were not modified:
    • api-collection/Panorra API Post/Auth/Login.yml
    • src/Worker/PostComplete/PostComplete.go

Background

Several small utility queries still use Config.DB.Raw or Config.DB.Exec even though the same behavior can be expressed with GORM chain APIs. These functions are called by multiple API actions and workers, so function signatures and return values must remain unchanged.

Objective

Refactor low-risk utility database calls to GORM chain APIs without changing any exported function signature, argument list, return type, response shape, or caller contract.

Scope

  • src/Utils/ElasticSearch/ElasticUsers/ElasticUsers.go
    • Convert follower count Raw SELECT queries to Table/Select/Where/Scan.
  • src/Utils/ElasticSearch/ElasticPost/ElasticPost.go
    • Convert total comment Raw SELECT queries to Table/Select/Where/Scan.
  • src/Utils/ElasticSearch/ElasticNotForPublic/ElasticNotForPublic.go
    • Convert reply/comment like Raw SELECT queries to Table/Select/Where/Scan.
  • src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go
    • Convert UpdateLastLogin update to Table/Where/Update.
    • Convert InsertElasticContainer insert to Table/Create.
    • Convert bookmark lookup join to Table/Select/Joins/Where/Scan.

Constraints

  • Do not rename functions.
  • Do not change parameters or return types.
  • Do not change map keys, ElasticSearch document fields, Redis keys, or response data.
  • Do not refactor complex raw SQL outside this task.
  • Keep existing error handling behavior, including ignored DB errors where the current function ignores them.

Acceptance Criteria

  • No Config.DB.Raw( or Config.DB.Exec( remains in the scoped files.
  • Refactored functions compile without caller changes.
  • Existing public utility behavior is preserved.
  • Verification passes with:
go test ./src/Utils/ElasticSearch/... ./src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions

issues.display_title: Issue #404: Refactor Additional and Post Handler Exec Queries
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 23/07/26

✅ Implementation: Refactor Additional and Post Handler Exec Queries

This document tracks the execution details for the non-worker Exec refactor.

Phase 1: Additional Version

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Additional/Version.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models, uuid, and time imports.
    • Replaced Exec INSERT INTO app_versions with Config.DB.Create(&Models.AppVersions{...}).
    • Replaced Exec UPDATE app_versions with Config.DB.Model(&Models.AppVersions{}).Where(...).Updates(...).
    • Preserved validation, duplicate checks, missing update checks, response messages, and status codes.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 2: Additional Change Username

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Additional/ChangeUsername.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced Exec UPDATE users with Config.DB.Model(&Models.User{}).Where("encrypt = ?", encrypt).Update("username", username).
    • Preserved Redis refresh, ElasticSearch update, response payload, and function signature.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 3: Post Handler Processing Flags

  • Target File:
    • src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced Exec UPDATE posts SET is_uploading = false, is_processing = true with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Post{}).Where(...).Updates(...).
    • Preserved RabbitMQ publish ordering, error logging, response payload, and function signature.
  • Status: Completed.

Verification

  • Ran gofmt on all modified Go files.
  • Ran:
go test ./src/Action/V1/Additional ./src/Controllers/V1/Posts
  • Result: passed, both packages reported no test files.
  • Ran scoped raw SQL scan:
rg -n "Config\.DB\.Exec\(" src\Action\V1\Additional\Version.go src\Action\V1\Additional\ChangeUsername.go src\Controllers\V1\Posts\PostsHandlers.go
  • Result: no matches.

Notes

  • No worker files were touched in this batch.

Background

Several non-worker endpoints still use Config.DB.Exec for simple insert and update queries. These calls can use existing GORM models while preserving endpoint responses and caller behavior.

Objective

Replace scoped non-worker Exec calls with GORM model operations.

Scope

  • src/Action/V1/Additional/Version.go
    • Replace app_versions insert/update Exec calls.
  • src/Action/V1/Additional/ChangeUsername.go
    • Replace users.username update Exec call.
  • src/Controllers/V1/Posts/PostsHandlers.go
    • Replace post processing flag update Exec call.

Constraints

  • Do not touch any file under src/Worker.
  • Do not change endpoint response payloads or status codes.
  • Do not change function signatures.
  • Do not change Redis, ElasticSearch, RabbitMQ, or encryption behavior.
  • Do not refactor unrelated raw SQL.

Acceptance Criteria

  • No Config.DB.Exec( remains in the scoped files.
  • Version still validates duplicate insert and missing update cases.
  • ChangeUsername still updates Redis and ElasticSearch after DB update.
  • AddPostCompleteV1 still publishes RabbitMQ message before updating post flags.
  • Verification passes with:
go test ./src/Action/V1/Additional ./src/Controllers/V1/Posts
